title: Budding Ametist
description: This mod adds the ability to create Budding ametist. You will need amethyst shards.
body: By installing this mod, you can create Budding amethyst, a block on which amethyst crystals grow. To craft it, you will need an amethyst block and 4 amethyst crystals. You can use a workbench or the 4/4 crafting grid built into your inventory.
